note: What a bribe scene says of the offer (src/director/bribe-facts.ts): the vote the offerer wants by the side their group takes on the bill (interest-groups.ts LobbyMeeting.side, groupStance), and a contract by the budget line it is for (contracts.ts). Words only; nothing here is a number the world runs on.

voteWanted.spread: Words only: the side said after "vote".
voteWanted.checkedAgainst: interest-groups.ts LobbyMeeting.side: an employers' group is against.

contractByLine.spread: Words only: a public contract said by the budget line it pays from (contracts.ts subjectId contract:<government>:<line>:<date>).

groupArticle.spread: Words only: the article an interest group's name is said with ("the Employers' association").
groupArticle.checkedAgainst: interest-groups.ts names its groups by their interest ("Employers' association").
